_comment: Curated text for docs/flags.md, which internal/serveapp/flagsdoc_test.go generates from serve's real flags (registerFlags). Every flag needs an entry here and every entry needs a flag; the test fails otherwise. Regenerate the page with: go test ./internal/serveapp -run TestFlagsDoc -update. Groups appear in the order their first flag does. type is needed only for flags whose Go type says nothing (custom values, enums); default only for defaults that vary by platform or environment. summary is plain prose: no commit hashes, no measurement diaries; the long text stays in --help.

groups.Choosing models: What to serve. `--model` is the one flag most invocations need.
groups.Memory and swap safety: Read these before loading a model that is close to your RAM or VRAM.
groups.Backend, precision and context: Which compute backend runs the model, at what precision, with how much context.
groups.Concurrency and queues: How many requests run at once, and what happens to the rest.
groups.Sessions and KV cache: Keeping conversations warm between requests, and across restarts.
groups.Speculative decoding: Lossless drafting: output is identical to plain decoding, only the speed changes.
groups.Network and security: Where the server listens and who may talk to it.
groups.Admin and halt: Controlling a running server without restarting it.

flags.name: model
flags.summary: What to serve: a `.gguf` or `.giw` file, a model directory, or a reference fetched on first use (`hf:owner/repo:quant`, `demo:<tier>`). Repeatable; `name=path` serves several models from one process, with optional per-model overrides after the path.

flags.name: served-model-name
flags.summary: The id `/v1/models` reports for a single unnamed `--model` (default: the file or directory name).

flags.name: lora
flags.summary: A PEFT LoRA adapter directory, merged into a safetensors base at load.

flags.name: adapter
flags.summary: A compute-time LoRA adapter that shares a base model's resident weights. Repeatable. Needs a dense safetensors base; not compatible with `--stream-weights`.

flags.name: vision
flags.summary: Vision tower directory for a multimodal `--model` (found automatically per family); enables image content parts. Defaults to the `--model` directory when it holds a tower.

flags.name: vision-quant
flags.summary: Vision encoder precision: `f32` (bit-exact) or `int8`, which only speeds up the vision encoder on AVX512-VNNI CPUs.

flags.name: embed-model
flags.summary: An embedding model directory (CodeRankEmbed layout), served on `/v1/embeddings`.

flags.name: embed-quant
flags.summary: Embedding weight precision.

flags.name: embed-served-model-name
flags.summary: The id `/v1/models` reports for the embedding model (default: the directory name).

flags.name: fit
flags.summary: Size an unpinned load to what this machine actually has instead of a flat historical default, for example a larger CUDA context when the card has the free VRAM. `--fit=off` restores the fixed defaults.

flags.name: stream-weights
flags.summary: Run a model bigger than your RAM: page weights from disk instead of holding them resident. The flag to know before loading something large.

flags.name: weight-cache
flags.summary: Resident expert-weight budget in GB for `--stream-weights`. 0 = automatic, about half of available RAM.

flags.name: accept-slow
flags.summary: Load a `--stream-weights` paged-MoE model even when its predicted decode rate is below the 2 tok/s floor. Without this, such a load is refused and the predicted rate is named.

flags.name: moe-cache-experts
flags.summary: Run a MoE model whose experts exceed VRAM or RAM by streaming routed experts to the GPU per token. Bit-identical to fully resident, at the cost of a transfer per token. Off by default.

flags.name: moe-cache-slots
flags.summary: Per-layer expert slots to keep resident for a paged MoE model. On CUDA this is an upper bound: it is lowered if free VRAM cannot hold it.

flags.name: moe-pager
flags.summary: Backing mode for the expert pager of a `.giw`-paged MoE model: `mmap` (zero-copy, but on macOS the memory budget is not enforced) or `pool` (owned buffers, a firm cap on every platform).

flags.name: require-backend
flags.summary: Exit non-zero at startup if a model did not get the requested `--backend`'s fast paths (no resident decode, or a prefill that fell back to the per-token loop). For batch jobs that should fail at second zero rather than run slow.

flags.name: backend
flags.summary: The compute backend. `--version` lists the backends compiled into this binary; naming one that is not there falls back to `cpu`.

flags.name: quant
flags.summary: Weight precision, the accuracy, speed and RAM trade-off. `int4` is the default; `f32` is unquantized. A prequantized `.giw` carries its own.
flags.type: int4 | int4mix | q4k | int8int8 | int8 | f32

flags.name: embed-int4
flags.summary: With `--quant int4`, keep the token-embedding and LM-head table at int4 as well, halving the largest resident tensor on a small model with a big vocabulary. `--embed-int4=false` keeps it at int8.

flags.name: kv
flags.summary: KV cache precision: `f32` is bit-exact; `f16` and `i8` are lossy and smaller (`f16` applies to GPU-resident models only).

flags.name: kv-quant
flags.summary: Overrides the CPU KV cache precision alone.

flags.name: ctx
flags.summary: GPU-resident KV capacity in positions. 0 keeps the backend default, which `--fit` may raise.

flags.name: direct-load
flags.summary: Load a plain `.gguf` straight into memory instead of through its sidecar `.giw` cache. Also enabled by setting `GOINFER_GGUF_DIRECT`.

flags.name: exact-prefill
flags.summary: Force bit-exact prompt ingestion on every backend, turning off the faster prefill paths that are not bit-identical. For diffing outputs across versions or reproducing a bug.

flags.name: cpu-exact-prefill
flags.summary: The same, for the CPU backend only: the f64-accumulating attention kernel instead of the faster f32 default.

flags.name: max-concurrent
flags.summary: How many generations of one model run at once, capped by `--kv-sessions`. GPU-resident models run several only where the backend can batch their decode; vision and weight-streaming models, and `--spec` without `--spec-adaptive`, run one.

flags.name: max-queue
flags.summary: Requests that may wait per model before new ones get a 429. 0 = unbounded.

flags.name: max-inflight
flags.summary: Global cap on concurrent inference requests, applied before the per-model queue. A full cap returns 503 with `Retry-After`. 0 = unbounded.

flags.name: cpu-batch
flags.summary: Whether concurrent CPU generations of one model join their decode tokens into one batched forward (replies are bit-identical either way). `auto` batches models with at least 2 GiB of dense weights.

flags.name: prefill-chunk
flags.summary: On a GPU-resident model serving several generations, prefill a long prompt that arrives mid-decode in chunks of this many tokens, with a decode step between chunks. 0 = off.

flags.name: max-body-bytes
flags.summary: Cap on request-body size in bytes; a larger body is rejected with 413 before it is read. 0 derives the cap from the model's context window.

flags.name: kv-sessions
flags.summary: Conversations kept prefilled in RAM for prompt-prefix reuse. 0 disables. On GPU backends this is also how many resident KV slots a model keeps, clamped by its memory guard.

flags.name: session-dir
flags.summary: Directory that persists and restores KV sessions across restarts.

flags.name: kv-idle-demote
flags.summary: Demote a warm session's KV to `--session-dir` once it has been idle this long (for example `10m`); it faults back in on the next matching request. 0 = off.

flags.name: kv-demoted-max
flags.summary: Maximum demoted (on-disk) sessions to keep; older ones are dropped. Only with `--kv-idle-demote`.

flags.name: job-dir
flags.summary: Directory for a durable job journal: one line per generation state change. After a restart, a job still running at its last recorded change is marked `interrupted`. Off by default.

flags.name: spec
flags.summary: Lossless n-gram (prompt-lookup) speculative decoding. Wins on copy-heavy traffic such as code edits, RAG and agent loops. Serves one generation at a time unless `--spec-adaptive` is also set.

flags.name: spec-adaptive
flags.summary: Experimental. With `--spec ngram`, keeps concurrent generations: one speculates only while it is alone and joins batched decode when others arrive. Needs a resident whose decode can batch. Early measurements found it slower than plain `--spec ngram` under copy-heavy load, so it is not recommended there.

flags.name: drafter
flags.summary: A pretrained block-drafter directory (DFlash) paired with `--model`: it proposes a block of tokens per round and the target verifies them in one pass. Lossless; greedy requests only; needs a resident GPU backend.

flags.name: addr
flags.summary: Listen address. Loopback by default; bind `0.0.0.0` only with `--api-key` and TLS, or behind a TLS-terminating proxy.

flags.name: api-key
flags.summary: Shared secret every request must send as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key`. Falls back to `$GOINFER_API_KEY`. Required to bind anywhere but loopback, and with `--allow-admin`.

flags.name: tls-cert
flags.summary: PEM certificate file. With `--tls-key`, serves HTTPS instead of plaintext HTTP.

flags.name: tls-key
flags.summary: PEM private key file, paired with `--tls-cert`.

flags.name: web
flags.summary: Serve a local browser UI at `/` to chat and to pull GGUF checkpoints from Hugging Face. Off by default: its pull route starts multi-gigabyte downloads.

flags.name: allow-admin
flags.summary: Enable `/admin/*` on the TCP listener: model load and unload, cancel, halt, resume. A deliberate opt-in that requires `--api-key`. Ignored when `--admin-socket` is set.

flags.name: admin-socket
flags.summary: Serve `/admin/*` on a Unix socket (mode 0600, no key check: file permissions are the auth) instead of TCP. The same binary controls it with `status`, `ls`, `cancel`, `halt` and `resume`.

flags.name: halt-file
flags.summary: Poll this path every 250 ms: present halts the server (inference routes return 503 and in-flight generations are cancelled), absent resumes it. A supervisor halts with `touch` and resumes with `rm`.

flags.name: halt-exit-code
flags.summary: When nonzero, a halt exits the process with this code once every cancelled generation has stopped, for supervisors whose restart policy must not undo a deliberate halt. 0 = a halt never exits.

flags.name: unload-drain-wait
flags.summary: How long `POST /admin/models/unload` waits for in-flight requests to drain before returning 202.

flags.name: version
flags.summary: Print the version, the backends compiled into this binary, and the Go toolchain, then exit.

flags.name: decisions-template
flags.summary: Prompt template for `POST /v1/systemone`: `chat-v1` (the model's chat template) or `bare-v1` (no chat template).

flags.name: decisions-calibration
flags.summary: A `calibration.json` of per-kind temperatures for `/v1/systemone`. Without it, answers are uncalibrated.

subcommands.summary: Fetch a model, sha256-verified, into the local cache.
Drive a running server through a harness conversation and print per-feature verdicts.
Control a running server over its `--admin-socket`.
Print the version and the backends compiled into this binary.
